999008199.text:
……永遠。
昨夜の鏑矢様のことでござるが……
ああ。俺も色々と思うところがあるさ

localizations.en: Yeah. I've got a lot on my mind about it too.

999008199.text:
まさか鏑矢様が、戦を考えているなんて……
昔から、好戦的な面はござったが……

localizations.en: I never would have imagined Lady Kaburaya contemplating war... She's always had a combative streak, but...

999008199.text:
やはりコウセンに何か吹き込まれたに違いない。
そうでなけりゃ、鏑矢が自ら戦なんて考えないだろう

localizations.en: Kosen must have put ideas in her head. There's no way Kaburaya would consider war on her own otherwise.

999008199.text: ……まあ、コウセンが何かしている証拠はないんだが

localizations.en: ...Though I don't have any actual proof that Kosen's up to something.

999008199.text:
今夜、コウセンのいない場で鏑矢に
話を聞けないものか……なんとか説得したいが……

localizations.en: Tonight, could we speak with Kaburaya when Kosen isn't around? I'd really like to try persuading her somehow...

999008199.text: ん、この足音は……千歳殿でござるな？

localizations.en: Hmm, those footsteps... That's Chitose, isn't it?

999008199.text: 鬼門様、永遠様、あの……
どうしたでござるか、千歳殿？

その……少し、不安になってしまって……
あのような衝突は、久々だったので……

localizations.en: Well... I'm feeling a bit anxious... It's been such a long time since we had a confrontation like that...

999008199.text:
すまない、俺も感情的になるつもりはなかったのさ。
まさか鏑矢があんなことを考えているなんて……

localizations.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to get so emotional. I just never expected Kaburaya to be thinking something like that...

999008199.text:
ほんと、永遠と鏑矢様がケンカを始めるかと思って
拙者も千歳殿も、どうしたものかと思っていたでござる

localizations.en: Seriously, when I thought you and Lady Kaburaya were about to start fighting, Chitose and I had no idea what to do.

999008199.text:
ケンカを始めて、またあの時みたいに
天守閣に穴を開けてしまうのではないかと……

localizations.en: I was worried you'd start brawling and end up punching another hole in the castle tower like that one time...

999008199.text: ……ふふ、あれは、少し面白かったです……

localizations.en: ...Hehe, that was kind of funny though...

999008199.text:
鬼門様が、お二人を止めてくださって助かりました。
先ほども、あの時も

localizations.en: I'm grateful that you stopped them, Kimon. Just now, and back then too.

999008199.text:
私は……勢いに圧されて、動けなかったので……
武装計画についても、詳しくは知らされていなくて……

localizations.en: I... get overwhelmed by that kind of intensity and freeze up... And I haven't been told much about the armament project either...

999008199.text: 鏑矢に近い千歳も、詳しくは知らされていないのか……

localizations.en: Even you, who's close to Kaburaya, haven't been told the details...

999008199.text:
今夜、皆様で話し合われるのですよね。
そこで上手く話はまとまるでしょうか……

localizations.en: You're all going to discuss it tonight, right? Do you think you'll be able to work things out?

999008199.text:
大丈夫でござるよ！　拙者と永遠が鏑矢様を説得して、
またいつもの４人に戻るでござる！

localizations.en: It'll be fine! Towa and I will convince Lady Kaburaya, and we'll get back to being our usual group of four!

999008199.text: 仲直りのない衝突はないでござるから！

localizations.en: After all, there's no conflict that can't end in reconciliation!

999008199.text:
……はい！　安心しました……
では、鬼門様、永遠様。私はこれで

localizations.en: ...Yes! That puts me at ease... Well then, Kimon, Towa, I'll be going now.

999008199.text:
千歳殿を心配させちゃったでござるな。
また４人で居るためにも、鏑矢様を説得しなければ

localizations.en: We really made Chitose worry, didn't we? We absolutely have to convince Lady Kaburaya so the four of us can be together again.

999008199.text:
ああ、そうだね。
そこでなんだが鬼門

localizations.en: Yeah, absolutely. Which brings me to something, Kimon.

999008199.text:
あの意固地な鏑矢を説得するためには、
説得させられるだけの情報が必要だ

localizations.en: To convince that stubborn Kaburaya, we're going to need compelling enough information to actually change her mind.

999008199.text:
そして俺はコウセンを怪しいと思っている。
あいつには何か思惑があるに違いない

localizations.en: And I think there's something suspicious about Kosen. That guy definitely has some kind of agenda.

999008199.text: ……つまり？

鬼門の力を貸してくれ。
二人で、コウセンという人物を調べようじゃないか

localizations.en: I need your help, Kimon. Let's investigate this Kosen character together.
